title: App tab is a blank white sheet on the Duo
where: Project App tab: the whole content sheet left of the rail
why: Book Club, Neighbourhood Swap and Watering Rota each show an empty white card under the header, with no loading or error state. The same projects draw their content on both Android shapes, so on the Duo the app looks broken.

title: Project hub says 'Nothing more to vote on.' while a vote is waiting
where: Book Club hub, first line of the FOR YOU card
why: Communities shows '1 vote waiting on you · Book Club', the bot's Needs you shows a Vote and the request shows '0 of 2 yes votes'. Book Club's own page still says 'Nothing more to vote on.', so it hides the one thing it asks of the person. 'more' also suggests they have just finished voting.

title: Workshop and Proposals captures both open the Hub
where: Whole page: the header subtitle says 'Hub', and the tablet sidebar lights Hub
why: On every shape, both screens show the same Book Club Hub. The Workshop board and the proposals list never appear, so a link to either one opens the wrong tab. If the capture navigated by route, the routes redirect to the Hub.

title: Request page header says 'Hub' while you are in the Workshop
where: Header subtitle under 'Book Club'; tablet sidebar project sub-list
why: The breadcrumb right under the header reads '< Workshop', so the two disagree about where you are. On the tablet, none of App, Hub, Needs you or Workshop is lit while a request is open, so nothing shows where you are.

title: Audience names mix Public/Private and 'Private community' with Group/Community/Just you
where: Communities filter chips; hub hero subtitle
why: The filters read 'Public 2 · Private 1 · Just you 1', and Book Club (a Group) is described as 'Private community · 3 members'. The product calls these audiences Just you, Group and Community, so the same project has two names and 'community' means both the container and an audience.

title: Group chat 'Flat 4B' is listed under DIRECT MESSAGES
where: Messages list section label; tablet sidebar 'Direct messages' sub-list
why: Flat 4B is a 3-member group (its header says 'you own this group'), but it appears under the 'Direct messages' heading with an ordinary one-letter avatar. The heading is wrong as soon as a group exists.

title: Phone Messages rows are styled differently from the same list on tablet
where: Conversation list rows
why: On phone and Duo the rows sit on the bare background with regular-weight ~16px names, no time and a single 'A' tile even for the group. The tablet draws the same list in a card with bold 15px titles, '29m ago', stacked avatars and a member pill. The phone version breaks the bold 15-over-13 row style and the card style.

title: Floating chat header buttons sit on top of messages
where: Top-right of the conversation, just under the header
why: The ••• and members circles float over the scrolling messages. In the DM with the keyboard up, the ••• covers the timestamp (it reads '9:14 ·M'). In the group, the members button overlaps the corner of a bubble. They need their own band or a backdrop.

title: Jump-to-latest chevron covers request text
where: Centre of the request card, just above the Reply box
why: The round chevron sits on 'CHANGE #3 · L…'. With the keyboard up, it covers 'on the' in the bold title 'and vote on the next one', so those lines can't be read.

title: Vote controls are four differently coloured pills with zero counts
where: Under the bot's 'I built this. It's up for a vote' message; 'Vote · 0/2' pill on phone
why: '0 of 2 yes votes' has a purple outline, 'Preview' is blue, 'Yes (0)' green and 'No (0)' red. That puts four hues on one row, with a purple outside the one-blue palette (also on the phone's 'Vote · 0/2' dot), and shows zeros in brackets. On the Duo the row wraps and leaves 'No (0)' alone on a second line.

title: The same decision is called vote, approve and yes in different places
where: Bot Needs you row, bot chat card, request timeline, Communities
why: The words vary by screen: 'Vote' and '1 to vote' in lists, an 'Approve' button with 'Needs 2 approvals from you, @audit_ben or @audit_cy' in the chat card, 'Ready for your yes', 'asked for approval' and '0 of 2 yes votes'. People can't tell whether approving and voting are the same action.

title: Request timeline shows internal words and broken lines
where: Request timeline entries
why: 'audit_ada created issue: …' uses the internal word 'issue' for a request. The bot is 'homeroom_bot' on one line and 'Homeroom bot' on the next. '· 9:24 PM' and '· 9:27 PM · on Change #3' wrap onto their own lines, each starting with a dot.

title: Zero counts are shown instead of saying nothing
where: Homeroom bot summary line; Profile stat tiles
why: The bot shows 'Needs you: 1 · In progress: 0', with colon labels instead of phrases and a zero. Profile opens with two large tiles reading '0 live' and '0 challenges'. Counts should be phrases, and zero should show nothing.

title: Pages repeat their own title as a second large heading
where: Homeroom bot top card; project hub hero
why: The header says 'Homeroom bot', then a 28px card heading says 'Homeroom bot' again. The tablet Hub shows header 'Book Club', a page title 'Hub' and a hero 'Book Club', which is two large headings plus the header. A page should have at most one large heading.

title: A project's header switches between teal and neutral across its tabs
where: Top header bar and primary button on project pages
why: Hub and request pages paint the header in the project's teal and use a filled teal 'Open app'. The same project's App tab has a neutral header, with Suggest on tablet and an X on phone. That gives the same project two header looks, and teal becomes a second action colour beside the blue '2 new' and 'Notify me'.

title: 'Neighbourhood Swap' label breaks in the middle of a word
where: Home > My apps, label under the N icon
why: It wraps as 'Neighbour / hood Swap' on Android and 'Neighbourh / ood Swap' on the Duo. Labels should wrap at spaces or truncate, not split inside a word.

title: Book Club row subtitle is cut off by the '1 to vote' pill
where: Communities list, Book Club row
why: The subtitle reads '1 in progress · 2…', so '2 new messages · 3 members' is lost to make room for a pill. The pill repeats the 'NEEDS YOU · 1 vote waiting on you' card directly above it.

title: iOS chevron-in-a-circle back buttons on Android
where: Header, left of the title, on pushed screens
why: Discover, chats, Settings, Challenges and project pages use a '<' chevron in a tinted disc. Android's convention is a plain left arrow (Material arrow_back) with no disc, so the app reads as an iOS port.

title: Other iOS idioms on Android: horizontal ••• menus, row chevrons, pill segmented controls
where: Chat and request overflow buttons; settings rows; Discover and Challenges tabs
why: The overflow menus are horizontal ••• circles where Android uses a vertical ⋮. Every settings row ends in an iOS disclosure '>'. For you/Browse/Joined is an iOS-style pill segmented control rather than Material tabs or chips.

title: App frame runs under the Android navigation bar
where: Bottom edge of a project's App tab
why: The app sheet goes to the bottom of the screen with no bottom inset. The template's footer line 'disappears once you build your real app.' ends at about 597px, past the 592px top of the 48px navigation bar, so the last 48px of any app sits under the system bar. The shell's own tab bar does keep clear of it.

title: Hub cards run almost to the screen edge
where: 'Hear from Book Club?' and FOR YOU cards on the hub
why: These cards start about 5px from the left edge, while the hero above and the cards on every other screen keep a 16px gutter. The FOR YOU label is out of line with both.

title: Tablet Home and Discover don't use the wide screen sensibly
where: Home My apps row and search bar; Discover search, tabs and grid
why: Four small app icons are spread about 250px apart across the full width. The Home search bar touches the header with no gap. On Discover, the search box and For you/Browse/Joined stop at about 575px while the card grid below runs about 1000px, and the ALL APPS label is indented about 16px from the cards.

title: Tablet bot chat bubbles look torn by inline thread rows
where: Main Chat pane on the right of the Homeroom bot tab
why: The row 'B ▷ #1 Let members suggest a book… Ready for your yes · 4 updates' is drawn across the bot's bubbles. The 'Plan: … I'm building it now.' bubble loses its bottom border, and the next bubble starts with no top edge. A stray scrollbar thumb also floats in the gap between the list and the chat.

title: Settings list: odd search field, a bookmark on every row, truncated labels
where: Settings search box and row trailing controls
why: 'Find a setting' is a grey, boxed, square-cornered field with no icon, unlike the white pill search fields elsewhere, and a large dead gap follows it. Every row has an unexplained bookmark plus a chevron, which squeezes labels ('Linked ph… 1 linked', 'Phones signed in…', 'GitHub and X, for your wee…'). The first row, 'Account', repeats its ACCOUNT section label.

title: Tablet Settings: 'Account' opens a pane titled 'Profile' with three large headings
where: Settings right pane; left list section labels
why: With 'Account' lit, the pane's headings are 'Profile', 'Sign-in' and 'Delete account', all large and none called Account. 'INTEGRATIONS & AUTOMATION' wraps onto two lines in the narrow list.

title: Discover rows are very tall, and every row has a filled Join button
where: Discover > ALL APPS list
why: Each row is about 95px tall, with about 36px between the title and 'Updated 40m ago', so three apps fill the phone screen. Every row carries a filled blue '+ Join', so the list is a column of primary buttons. Home's cards use a white Join with blue text, so the same action has two looks.

title: Empty Challenges page looks unfinished and doesn't match Home's empty state
where: Challenges screen body
why: The page is one grey line, 'No challenges right now.', under a left-aligned segmented control, and the rest of the screen is empty. Home shows the same empty state as a white card with a title and the line 'New ones will show up here.' The same state has two looks, and the page gives no next step.

title: Sender names have '@' in group chats but not in DMs
where: Message author line above bubbles
why: The group shows '@audit_cy' and '@audit_ada', while the DM shows 'audit_ben' and 'audit_ada'. Your own name and time are also printed in blue above your own bubbles, which chat apps usually omit.

title: Tablet sidebar badges change or vanish, and an unexplained dot appears
where: Left sidebar, COMMUNITIES section
why: Book Club's blue '1' disappears once it is expanded, and its 'Needs you' child shows no count. The 'All 4 communities' badge turns grey on the Hub. A grey dot sits beside 'App' with nothing wrong, though a status dot should only mean a problem.

title: Empty composer's send button looks enabled on requests but disabled in chats
where: Send button at the right of the composer
why: With nothing typed, the request 'Reply…' box shows a solid blue send button, while the DM and group 'Message…' boxes show a pale disabled one. It is the same component in two states for the same condition.

title: Pale capsule painted through the header above the Duo clock
where: Top of the right system column, from the header down to the 9:4x clock
why: The header runs across the top of the system column, and a pale rounded capsule about 55pt wide is painted through it, fading toward the clock. On the teal project header it shows as a white smear. On neutral screens it is faint, with a small blue smudge under the header's bottom edge beside the avatar chevron. It looks like a rendering artifact next to the system clock.

title: Duo Communities rail item keeps showing Book Club's icon everywhere
where: Right rail, second item
why: After you visit Book Club, the Communities item becomes a teal-framed 'B' with a grey badge. It stays that way on Profile, Settings and Challenges, and even inside Watering Rota's app. The tab then looks like a Book Club shortcut, and its badge loses the blue that marks a waiting vote.

title: Duo rail labels overflow or truncate, and the app chip's close button is tiny
where: Right rail items and the APPS chip
why: 'Communities' is wider than its lit pill and runs past both edges, and 'Messages' touches them. App chips truncate ('Neighbou…', 'Watering …'), and 'Homeroom bot' wraps to two lines while the others use one. The × that removes a recent app is about an 8pt target perched on the icon's corner.

title: Duo chat headers push their two-line titles against the top edge
where: Header, top-left
why: 'audit_ben / Direct message' and 'Flat 4B / 3 members · you own this group' start about 7pt from the top of the screen, while single-line titles such as 'Messages' sit centred about 22pt down. The chat headers look cramped against the edge.

title: Phone tab bar: Communities icon is drawn differently, and labels crowd at 360px
where: Bottom tab bar (right rail on the Duo)
why: Communities is the only icon drawn inside a rounded-square frame, and on Android its label sits about 3px lower than the other four. At 360px the five labels nearly touch ('Communities' and 'Homeroom bot' are about 7px apart), and the lit pill on Communities butts against the 'Homeroom bot' label.
